literal: Those who lack wealth will flourish at some time; those who lack grace are ruined, rising up again is rare.
translation: Those who lack material wealth may flourish at some point; but those who lack grace are utterly ruined, and for them to rise up again is impossible.
modern: பொருள் இல்லாதவர்கள் ஒரு காலத்தில் வளம் பெற்றுச் செழிக்கக்கூடும்; ஆனால் அருள் இல்லாதவர்கள் முற்றிலும் அழிந்தவர்கள் ஆவர், அவர்கள் மீண்டும் வாழ்வு பெறுவது அரிது.
explanation: This couplet contrasts the loss of material wealth with the loss of compassion or grace. Those who are poor in material wealth can still hope to prosper and bloom at some point in the future through effort. In contrast, those who lack compassion are truly destitute and ruined. For them, to recover their humanity and rise up again is extremely difficult, as grace is the essential foundation of life.
